Disclaimer: The HHAeXchange Mobile Application requires an active internet connection (3G, 4G, or WiFi).

Caring for Mom or Dad shouldn't mean chaos in the family group chat.

Caregiver is a family care coordination app for adult children and siblings caring for an aging parent. Each loved one gets one care hub with a shared calendar, medication tracker, tasks, care logs, vitals, document vault, and live updates, so everyone in the care circle stays aligned without endless texts.

Whether you're coordinating care at home, in assisted living, or from a distance, Caregiver helps families manage senior care in one shared place. Care is shared, visible, and organized so nothing gets missed. Families stay aligned, reduce stress, and spend less time tracking updates - and more time supporting the people they love.

SHARED MEDICATION TRACKER
Log doses, set reminders, and reduce "Did Dad take his meds?" anxiety. Everyone in the family sees what matters in one shared log.

SHARED CAREGIVER CALENDAR & APPOINTMENTS
Put doctor visits, therapies, and appointments in one shared calendar so siblings, helpers, and primary caregivers stay aligned—even across cities.

SHARED TASKS, CARE CHECKLISTS & DUE DATES
Turn vague worries into a shared task list: errands, follow-up items, home safety tasks, and care plan steps with notes and due dates everyone can act on together.

SHARED CARE LOGS, VITALS & HEALTH TRENDS
Log blood pressure, pulse, blood sugar, temperature, mood, and daily notes in one place. Bring clearer context to appointments and spot patterns over time.

SHARED DOCUMENT VAULT FOR ELDERLY PARENT RECORDS
Keep insurance cards, IDs, medication lists, and visit notes in one secure place, so the right file is there in stressful moments.

SHARED FAMILY UPDATES WITHOUT THE UPDATE TEXTS
See recent activity across medications, tasks, appointments, care logs, and documents. Fewer repeated questions; clearer accountability for everyone helping Mom or Dad.

FREE TO START
Essentials for care coordination are available without blocking the basics behind a paywall: calendar, tasks, medications, and care log notes. Free is your care hub as admin. Inviting family to edit with you is Premium — often with a short intro trial when Apple still offers one. Subscriptions (paid by the care hub admin) also add more loved one profiles, expanded document storage, health trend charts, and longer care log history. Invited family benefit on hubs they share.

PRIVACY & TRUST
Your family's information matters. We're supported by optional Premium subscriptions—not banner ads. Published by Calming Aura Studios LLC. Review our Privacy Policy in the app or on our website.

LEGAL

results.description:
Somehow you became the one who keeps track of it all — the pills, the appointments, who said they'd stop by. When a parent is getting older, a partner is in treatment, or someone you love needs care every day, it almost always lands on one person: you.

CircleCare shares the load. Create one care circle around the person you care for, invite the people who help, and everyone works from the same up-to-date picture, whether they live down the street or across the country.

EVERYONE ON THE SAME PAGE
- Medications, appointments, tasks and notes in one shared place
- See who did what: who gave a dose, who finished a task, who left a note
- The activity feed shows every update from everyone in the circle, so nobody has to ask "did anyone check?"
- With reminders on, if a dose isn't marked in time, the alert goes to the person taking it, then to the caregivers, then to the whole circle

MEDICATIONS, SHARED
- Daily, weekly or custom schedules, with reminders
- Mark a dose taken or skipped, and the whole circle sees it
- New: as-needed medications. Log a dose when it's given, like a pain reliever, and everyone can see when the last one was given and by whom

APPOINTMENTS AND TASKS
- One shared calendar for doctor visits, treatments and tests
- Assign tasks and appointments to someone, or leave them open for whoever can help
- Add notes and questions so the next person knows what happened

NEW: THE DAILY UPDATE
Each evening at 7 pm, the Home screen shows a short summary of what the circle logged that day. If something was logged, you get one quiet notification, with no health details in it. It's free, and you can turn it off.

HEALTH INFO WHEN IT MATTERS
Allergies, conditions, doctors, insurance and emergency contacts in one place, ready to share as text or a PDF. Keep documents like test results and insurance cards with the circle too.

FREE TO START, FAIR AS YOUR TEAM GROWS
Free: 1 care circle for you + 1 caregiver. The person you care for can join too and doesn't count toward that. Medications and reminders are free forever. No credit card needed.

Premium, for families with more helping hands:
- Unlimited family members: everyone who helps, in one circle
- Add by voice: say a medication, task or appointment and we fill in the form for you to check. On supported phones.
- Adherence reports to share with doctors, plus calendar import
- 1 GB of documents per circle
- AI care assistant
- Up to 5 care circles

Monthly or yearly, priced fairly for your country. Yearly includes a free trial. Only the person who creates the circle pays. Invited family members never pay.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
This is your family's health information, not ad data. No ads. We never sell your data. Only the people you invite can see your circle.

IN 8 LANGUAGES
English, Spanish, French, French (Canada), German, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil) and Portuguese (Portugal). Everyone chooses their own.

GET STARTED IN A FEW MINUTES
Create a care circle, add a medication or an appointment, and invite your family. Nobody should have to carry this alone.

Privacy Policy: https://circlecare.app/privacy/

results.description:
CareGiving is built for administrators, caregivers and loved-ones by providing a real-time environment to manage shifts, track daily protocols, and track and forecast caregiver profitability.

Built exclusively for the Apple ecosystem, the platform uses native CloudKit technology to sync data seamlessly across iOS and macOS without sending your private information to third-party servers.

ONE APP FOR EVERYONE 

Every user experiences a tailored interface based on their specific role in their care journey:

FOR ADMINISTRATORS

* Master Care Programmes: Create detailed patient profiles to build comprehensive care blueprints.
* Operations & Financials: Use dedicated reporting dashboards to track caregiver profitability and forecast costs.
* Global Planner: Monitor live shifts and assign staff across your entire agency from a single visual calendar.
* System Sharing: Generate secure  .carebackup  financial files, or generate role-based CloudKit invite links for staff and family.

FOR CAREGIVERS

* The Timeclock & Location: Start your shift with a secure, one-tap GPS timeclock.
* The Active Shift Tab: Focus purely on care. Your daily priorities, baseline tasks, and medication schedules sync directly to your device.
* Real-Time Logging: Tap active medications to log exactly when vital appointments are met, ensuring a perfect audit trail. Log ad-hoc events instantly.

FOR THE CARE CIRCLE
* Monitor Live Progress: Accept your family invite to gain peace of mind. Watch in real-time as caregivers arrive on-site and check off tasks.
* The Care Blueprint: View the master care programme being followed. We believe no one with the heart to help should be left without a clear path.
* History & Audits: Review past shifts and view the complete Medication Ledger to ensure quality of care over time.

COORDINATION INBOX 

All roles are united by the Care Updates timeline—a central chat thread where the entire care team can log messages, share photos, and track system events seamlessly.

PRIVACY FIRST 

Absolute confidentiality is our priority. We leverage your private iCloud database to store and sync records. We do not harvest, read, or sell your operational data.

MEDICAL DISCLAIMER

Caregiving is an administrative coordination and scheduling tool. It is not a medical device. The App does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always seek the advice of your physician or other qualified health provider with any questions you may have regarding a medical condition. Never disregard professional medical advice or delay in seeking it because of something you have read or tracked in this App.

A donor-supported nonprofit founded in 1997, the organization offers tools to share and document a health journey, simplify care coordination, and connect caregivers with a supportive community. Caring for an aging parent is a family job, but it usually lands on one person. One sibling tracks the medications, another handles the appointments, and everyone else asks for updates in a group text that never quite has the answer. KinLoop gives your family one shared place to organize Mom's or Dad's care, so the people who love them can actually share the work.

HOW IT WORKS
Start a care circle for the person you are caring for. Invite family, close friends, and paid caregivers. From then on, everyone sees the same information at the same time. When you confirm a dose was taken, your brother sees it seconds later. When the home aide finishes a visit, the whole circle gets the note. No more "did anyone call the pharmacy?"

EVERYTHING ABOUT THEIR CARE, IN ONE PLACE
- Medications: every prescription with its schedule, who confirmed each dose, and refill reminders so nothing gets missed.
- Vitals: blood pressure, blood sugar, weight, heart rate, and more, with a history you can hand to the doctor.
- Appointments: a shared calendar with reminders, so someone is always lined up to drive.
- Tasks: assign groceries, bills, rides, and errands, and see them actually get done.
- Help Board: post the ride to dialysis or the Tuesday pickup, and let someone claim it. Asking a group text for help is how a favor gets lost. Asking here is how it gets covered.
- Caregiver shifts: know who is with them today and hand off cleanly between visits.
- Symptoms and behavior: write down what you are seeing in a few taps, with prompts that match their conditions, and see which time of day it keeps happening.
- Updates: a private family feed for daily notes, photos, voice memos, and quick reactions, instead of a scattered text thread.
- Their profile: conditions, allergies, doctors, pharmacy, insurance, daily routine, and what comforts them, so a new helper can step in with confidence.
- Medical Summary: a one-page snapshot of conditions, allergies, medications, and contacts, ready to hand to a clinician at an appointment or a new specialist.
- Coming home from the hospital: a walk through the medicines, the follow-up visit, and the first few days, for the week a family is least equipped for.
- Documents: care plans, advance directives, and records kept together and shared only with your circle.
- Expenses and mileage: track what care costs and export it at tax time.

FOR THE CAREGIVER, TOO
Most caregiving apps track the patient. KinLoop also looks after you. Quick daily check-ins for mood, energy, and stress, a private journal, gentle self-care reminders, and a weekly view that helps you notice burnout before it takes over. Caring for someone should not cost you your own health.

BUILT FOR REAL FAMILIES
- Works on iPhone, iPad, and the web, so everyone can join from whatever they already use.
- Follows the text size you have already set on your phone, so the screens stay readable without changing anything in the app.
- Available in English, Spanish, and French.
- Private by design. Your family's information is shared only with the people you invite, and you can remove anyone at any time.

PLANS
Every care circle starts with room for up to three people. Full Circle unlocks unlimited members, care reports, the care journal, calendar sync, and unlimited storage. One Full Circle plan covers every care circle you manage, so if you are looking after both parents, you are covered once.

Privacy Policy: https://mykinloop.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://mykinloop.com/terms

KinLoop helps your family coordinate care. It is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice or emergency services. In an emergency, call 911 or your local emergency number. Always follow your care team's guidance.

Brelti is a care coordination app designed to help families manage the complex, everyday work of caregiving—together, in one place.

Created by caregivers, Brelti brings your entire care team, important information, and daily tasks into a single, organized system—making care easier to coordinate and easier to sustain.

With Brelti, you can:
• Organize medical, legal, financial, and personal documents in one secure vault

AI-POWERED ASSISTANCE, BUILT FOR REAL CARE

• Schedule appointments and create calendar events
• Find nearby providers and store their information
• Upload and organize documents
• Manage medications and care notes

Bella is designed to support organization and coordination—not to provide medical advice or diagnoses.

A VAULT THAT GOES BEYOND MEDICAL RECORDS
Unlike simple “medical binder” apps, Brelti’s vault is built for the full reality of caregiving. You can store and organize documents across multiple categories, including medical records, insurance, legal paperwork, financial documents, housing information, identity documents, notes, and recordings—all in one place.

BUILT FOR TEAMS, NOT JUST INDIVIDUALS
Care rarely falls on one person alone. Brelti lets you invite family members and caregivers, switch between care recipients, and keep everyone aligned without relying on scattered texts, emails, or notes apps.

DESIGNED WITH ACCESSIBILITY AND TRUST IN MIND
Brelti is built to be accessible and easy to use, with support for assistive technologies and clear, readable interfaces. Information entered into the app is provided by users and managed according to our privacy practices.

results.description:
ianacare is for family caregivers: anyone caring for a parent, spouse, child, or other loved one living with a chronic or serious illness, including dementia.

Caring for someone you love isn't the problem — it's figuring out the unknowns. ianacare helps you get answers, make a plan, and keep track of it all, with real human support behind every step for eligible programs.

Anyone can access iana, Action Plans, the care log, and family coordination, on your phone or computer. If ianacare comes through your employer or the Medicare GUIDE program, you may also have a Care Navigator and additional resources (see below).

CHAT WITH IANA™, YOUR AI CARE COMPANION
Caregiving doesn't have office hours. Ask iana about managing care around a new diagnosis, a difficult behavior, or what to ask the doctor tomorrow, and iana can help you think it through. iana is built on ianacare's I Am Not Alone Care Model, shaped by 50,000+ family journeys, and remembers your situation so you don't have to start over.

KNOW WHAT TO DO NEXT
Answer a few questions about where things stand today, and iana builds your Action Plan: a personalized, prioritized list of next steps with vetted resources and support options. It updates as your situation changes, so it's never a generic checklist.

KEEP TRACK OF THE DAY-TO-DAY
Quick Log captures care notes in a few taps — in the waiting room, the parking lot, or the kitchen at 6 a.m. Care Log History keeps every note and iana chat in one searchable place, and iana can summarize it before an appointment so you walk in prepared.

BRING IN FAMILY & FRIENDS, IF YOU WANT TO
Caring on your own? Everything above works for you. If others want to help, invite them to coordinate meals, rides, and tasks without the group text.

THROUGH YOUR EMPLOYER
If ianacare is a benefit at your work, you also get a Care Navigator, a trained caregiving expert you can message or schedule a call with. You'll also find benefits your employer offers, live events and support groups, and practical articles on the Community Hub. 

THROUGH THE MEDICARE GUIDE PROGRAM
The Medicare GUIDE program supports people living with dementia and the family members who care for them. If ianacare is your GUIDE provider, you may also have a dedicated Care Navigator, dementia-specific support, help arranging rest breaks (respite care), live events and support groups, and the Community Hub. If your Care Navigator is through another GUIDE provider, ianacare adds iana, tailored resources, and live events alongside that support. 

PRIVATE AND SECURE
ianacare follows HIPAA standards to protect your health information, and your data is encrypted to keep it safe. Your information is never sold or used for advertising, and you choose who on your team can see it.

IMPORTANT
iana is an AI, not a substitute for professional medical or mental health advice. Always talk with your care team about medical decisions. In a medical emergency, call 911. If you're in crisis, call or text 988.

Privacy Policy: https://ianacare.com/privacy-policy/
